name: excel
label: 读取 Excel/CSV
description: Read .xlsx/.xls/.csv files inside the repository and turn a worksheet into table text (repository paths only); at most 10 rows per page and page 1 by default - never page through everything automatically; when there are more pages, just state the total count, the rest is reachable through the frontend pager, and pass page only when the user explicitly asks for more.

filePath.description: path inside the repository, e.g. data/quote.xlsx

sheet.description: worksheet name or index (0-based), defaults to the first one

page.description: page number, at most 10 rows per page; page 1 by default, pass this only when the user explicitly asks for more
